title: [Bug][Subscription Billing] Contract Renewal Quote total ignores the Billing Base Period and shows the base-period amount instead of the renewal-term amount
summary: Contract Renewal Quote totals now show the renewal-term amount instead of the Billing Base Period amount. The contract-renewal calculation in Sales Subscription Line now converts from base period to billing rhythm before applying the renewal-term ratio, and period counts are reset per line.
key_points: Renewal quote totals reflect the renewal term, e.g. 1,200 instead of 100 for 1M base, 12M rhythm and 12M term
The contract-renewal branch lacked the base-period-to-rhythm conversion and applied only the renewal-term ratio
Both branches now share one period conversion
Period counts became per-line locals reset to 1, stopping values leaking between lines
New tests cover differing periods, empty base period and complex rhythm
